claim_verdicts.evidence: Docs: "A module is a collection of one or many .tf, .tf.json, .tofu, .tofu.json files kept together in a directory." "Separating various blocks into different files is purely for the convenience of readers and maintainers, and has no effect on the module's behavior." "OpenTofu always runs in the context of a single root module."

Docs: "The resource type and name together serve as an identifier for a given resource"; "Most arguments in this section depend on the resource type ... arguments defined specifically for the aws_instance resource type." Lesson limits itself to 'arguments such as name and node_image' (provider-defined), which holds. Address kind_cluster.this: outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-first-cluster.txt line 32 '# kind_cluster.this will be created'.

Requirements: "OpenTofu relies on plugins called 'providers' to interact with remote systems." Resource syntax: "Each resource type is implemented by a provider, which is a plugin for OpenTofu that offers a collection of resource types." Round 2: claim and sections 4/6, q1c, q3d now say 'has no resource type for kind or for the other systems you manage with it', which these sentences support; the round-1 overstatement ('knows no system's API') is gone.

search.opentofu.org page rendered empty via WebFetch. Provider package README (0.11.0, installed by init in first-cluster/.terraform): "enables Terraform to provision local Kubernetes clusters on base of Kubernetes IN Docker (kind)"; fields are used "for generating the kind config". Plan in tofu-first-cluster.txt lines 42-51 shows name, node_image, wait_for_ready, kind_config{kind, api_version, node}. kind.sigs.k8s.io: "a tool for running local Kubernetes clusters using Docker container 'nodes'".

Requirements: a provider requirement "consists of a local name, a source location, and a version constraint"; "If a resource doesn't specify which provider configuration to use, OpenTofu interprets the first word of the resource type as a local provider name." init docs: retrieves the necessary plugins from the registry. Repo: first-cluster/.terraform/providers/registry.opentofu.org/tehcyx/kind/0.11.0/ exists after init.

Requirements: source address is "[<HOSTNAME>/]<NAMESPACE>/<TYPE>"; namespace is "an organizational namespace within the specified registry"; hostname "If omitted, this defaults to registry.opentofu.org." Lock file at stage-3 (tools/extract-code) line 4: provider "registry.opentofu.org/tehcyx/kind" {. 'account that publishes it' is an acceptable plain rendering of the publishing namespace.

Docs: "The lock file is always named .terraform.lock.hcl", in the root module directory, created by tofu init; records version, constraints, hashes; should be committed. Repo @stage-3: lock file beside .terraform/, version 0.11.0, 1 h1: + 6 zh: hashes. .gitignore@stage-3: '.terraform/' under '# OpenTofu: providers downloaded by init'. Docs also: init pre-populates hashes "with all checksums reported by the registry ... across all supported platforms" (see section 4 minor).

Docs: "If a particular provider already has a selection recorded in the lock file, OpenTofu will always re-select that version for installation, even if a newer version has become available." Checksums: verifies each installed package, "returning an error if none of the checksums match." init -upgrade: "upgrade all previously-selected plugins to the newest version that complies with the configuration's version constraints."
Docs: with no existing selection OpenTofu "will select the newest available version that matches the given version constraint, and then update the lock file to include that selection."

Docs: "Validate runs checks that verify whether a configuration is syntactically valid and internally consistent, regardless of existing state." It validates "referring only to the configuration and not accessing any remote services such as remote state, provider APIs, etc." "Validation requires an initialized working directory with any referenced plugins and modules installed."

Version constraints: "= (or no operator): Allows only one exact version number." "~>: Allows only the rightmost version component to increment ... ~> 1.0.4 will allow installation of 1.0.5 and 1.0.10 but not 1.1.0." So ~> 1.10.0 allows 1.10.x, not 1.11.0. required_version constrains the OpenTofu CLI (settings page, as cited in round 1).

tools/extract-code main.tf --tag stage-3: lines 1-3 comment, 4-13 terraform block, 15-18 '# lesson: devops.l3.plan-and-apply' comment, 19 resource "kind_cluster" "this" {, 28 role = "control-plane", 29-31 closing braces only. Lesson block lines=4-28 matches character for character; Try it 'line 19' correct. Tracked files: main.tf and .terraform.lock.hcl (manifest example_files).

tools/extract-code @stage-3: script line 6 show() { echo "\$ $*"; "$@"; }; lines 8-17 match the lesson block verbatim. Output @stage-3 line 6 "- Reusing previous version of tehcyx/kind from the dependency lock file", line 7 "- Installing tehcyx/kind v0.11.0...", line 20 "$ tofu fmt -check" directly followed by line 21 validate, line 22 "Success! The configuration is valid." Elisions marked '...'.

Docs: "-check - Check if the input is formatted. Exit status will be 0 if all input is properly formatted. If not, exit status will be non-zero and the command will output a list of filenames whose files are not properly formatted." Captured output line 20 shows nothing after '$ tofu fmt -check'.

ci.yml@stage-3 job iac: setup-opentofu tofu_version 1.10.10; 'tofu fmt -check -recursive deploy/tofu'; loop over find deploy/tofu -name '*.tf' ! -path '*/modules/*' running 'init -backend=false -input=false' then 'validate'. .tf folders outside modules/: lessons/first-cluster, lessons/moved-into-module, envs/{staging,production}/{cluster,platform}. No step creates a cluster.

First half verified (output line 22 'Success! ...'; no cluster creation follows from validate docs). The failure for kind_clustr is in no captured output under outputs/stage-3 and in no doc page fetched; running tofu needed approval in this session and was not done. Wording 'no provider of the folder supplies a type kind_clustr' is generic enough not to depend on the exact message.

Validate docs: "not accessing any remote services such as remote state, provider APIs, etc." A pass therefore says nothing about the Docker engine. Provider README: clusters are provisioned with kind (Docker). Lesson places the failure 'later, when OpenTofu asks the provider to create the cluster', without over-specifying the step.

tools/extract-code STAGE.md --tag stage-3: "The scripts marked `# Runs on the host` need, on the host:" ... "- OpenTofu 1.10 (`scripts/devops/tofu-*.sh`, `dr-drill.sh`)." tofu-first-cluster.sh line 3: '# Runs on the host'.

init docs: "-input=false" errors if input is required; "-no-color" disables color codes. Backends: "If a configuration includes no backend block, OpenTofu defaults to using the local backend" (round 1). main.tf@stage-3 has no backend block (extract-code lines 4-13); captured output tofu-first-cluster.txt shows 'Initializing the backend...' as init's first line for that folder.

issues.text: Carried from round 1. Claim 16 still unverified: no capture or doc shows what `tofu validate` prints after `kind_cluster` becomes `kind_clustr` (meta notes: not run, needs approval). The wording is generic, but the Try it result is unobserved.
issues.quote: the second fails because no provider of the folder supplies a type `kind_clustr`
issues.fix: Run `tofu validate` after the edit once (tools/capture-output or by hand in first-cluster) and record the error in claim 16's source_hint; keep the current wording if the error names `kind_clustr`.

issues.text: New in changed text (junior fix). The lock file holds more than checksums of what init downloaded: docs say init pre-populates hashes "with all checksums reported by the registry, which usually covers all of the available packages for that provider version across all supported platforms"; the stage-3 file has 6 zh: hashes from one download. Claim 7 still says 'checksums of its packages', so lesson and ledger also differ.
issues.quote: the exact provider version it picked and checksums of what it downloaded, like an image digest
issues.fix: Write: "the exact provider version it picked and checksums the registry lists for that version, one per platform, like an image digest". Align claim 7's text with it.

issues.text: Carried from round 1. If `tofu version` fails I am told to 'install it first', with no hint how; that alone would not fit in 3 minutes. With `tofu` installed, the steps and the expected result are clear and checkable.
issues.quote: if `tofu version` fails, install it first.
issues.fix: Point to where `STAGE.md` (or an earlier lesson) says how OpenTofu 1.10 is installed, in one clause.
